_why: Bytes every page pays for before it can answer a tap, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI after the web build. History: in Oct 2026 a 1.4 MB all-locales i18n chunk was statically imported by the root layout, and Search Console marked all 578 URLs poor on mobile INP (244 ms); splitting it into one lazy catalogue per locale (PR #6351) fixed it, and these budgets stop it creeping back. Each is the value measured on build-app/ right after that fix plus ~15% headroom (rounded up to the KB); the web build's entry/layout/catalogue/CSS chunks are near-identical (same code, only prerender differs). Bytes, raw and gzip (level 9). Raising one is fine when deliberate: edit this file (`node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs <dir> --suggest` prints measured + 15%) and say why in the PR. globalCss was LOWERED in Oct 2026 (205,645 B raw / 35,311 B gz -> 152,387 / 30,851 measured on build-app/) when the non-Latin scripts' @font-face rules moved to per-locale sheets (src/lib/fonts-<locale>.css, linked only on that locale's documents) and the reader's optional faces to fonts-reader.css (linked once chosen) — see app.css's header and $lib/fontSheets.ts; the new value is that measurement + ~15%, so a face drifting back into app.css fails here.
_whyAppBundle: appBundle: the whole build-app/ folder the phone apps ship (every file, raw bytes), checked by scripts/build-app.mjs at the end of `npm run app:build`. Before Oct 2026 the app bundled all of static/ (245 MB: covers, share cards, portraits); covers, portraits, illustrations, og/ and pdfs/ now load from the website ($lib/assetUrl, app-assets.js) and the .woff font fallbacks are dropped, leaving 19.5 MB — nearly all webfonts (woff2) and JS. Budget = that + ~15%, rounded to the MB. A store app should stay small; raise it only deliberately, with the reason in the PR.
